$Comment: Writes the pack's hunting contracts, one per row below. Each row is one real quest, and every
child it writes is an ordinary quest file carrying Parent: zone_slay_base - so a generated
contract behaves exactly like a hand-written one, and any member that later needs to be special
can simply be written out as its own file under the same id.
HOW TO ADD A CONTRACT: copy a row, give it a fresh quest id, and write the matching
quest.<id>.title and quest.<id>.flavor lines into the pack's mmoskilltree.lang. Nothing else
needs touching. The id a row binds is the id the quest is saved under, so changing it starts
anyone mid-contract over.
THE ROW VOCABULARY, in the order it is used below:
quest        the quest id, which is also half of its two localization keys
giver        the character who offers it (an npc id from a placement's Identity.NpcId)
sort         where it sits in the quest log, low first
after        the quest that must be finished before this one is offered
gate_stat    the stat channel the level floor reads: MMO_TotalLevel is every skill summed,
MMO_Level_<SKILL> is one skill, MMO_CombatLevel is the best combat skill
gate_min     the floor itself; a contract with no level requirement binds 0, which everyone
already meets
target       the creature family to hunt, matched loosely so variants count
amount       how many
gift/gift_item/gift_count   an item handed over on completion; a contract that gives no
item leaves gift empty, and an empty Kind pays nothing out at all
xp1_*/xp2_*  up to two skill XP payouts, the second left empty when only one is wanted
